title: OrganizationalUnitMembership
description: Places one person in one OrganizationalUnit of an Organization. Lives in the organisation's eVault. There is one record per person per organisation: moving someone changes `unitId` on that record, so a person is never in two units or briefly in none. Taking someone out of every unit deletes the record; a person without a record is in no unit. Grants no authority.

organizationEName.description: eName of the organisation's eVault. Must be the eName of the vault the record lives in.

memberEName.description: The person placed in the unit

unitId.description: MetaEnvelope id of an OrganizationalUnit in the same vault

jobTitle.description: The person's title inside the unit, e.g. 'Senior engineer', 'Volunteer coordinator'. A label only: it grants nothing.

contractType.description: How the person works for the organisation, in the organisation's own words: 'Employee', 'Contractor', 'Volunteer', 'Intern', 'Elected member'. Free text, because the legal categories differ between countries. Optional: leave it out if the organisation doesn't want it shown.

since.description: When the person joined their current unit; reset on every move

createdAt.description: When the placement was first recorded

updatedAt.description: When this version of the record was written

authorization.description: Proof that the organisation authorised this change: the wallet signature (`w3ds-grant/v1`, over this record's canonical form) of someone holding the organisation's authority over its structure at `signedAt`. That is one of its directors (the `directors` of the vault's Company record, which every Organization has), or a person with a live Delegation in the same vault whose scopes include `ontology:ee75b09f-64e1-4ac9-ab8a-eac88a7e42f2` (named by `delegationId`). A record without such a signature is not part of the organisation's structure, whichever platform wrote it. Readers check this; the eVault does not.

signerEName.description: eName of the director or delegate who signed this version

signedPayload.description: The exact canonical string that was signed

signature.description: The signer's wallet signature over signedPayload

signedAt.description: When it was signed; the signer's authority is judged at this time

delegationId.description: Present when the signer acts under a Delegation rather than as a director: MetaEnvelope id of that Delegation, in the same vault, with the scope `ontology:ee75b09f-64e1-4ac9-ab8a-eac88a7e42f2`
